# Little Jem

## Overview

- **Age:** Over a year old at the end of Volume 4  <sub>[v4 c19 P12](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0012), [v4 c22 P15](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0015), [v4 c34 P10](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0010)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v4 c19 P7](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0007)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v4 c19 P7](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0007)</sub>
- **Origin:** Four Winds Harbor, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v4 c5 P16](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0016), [v4 c19 P0](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0000)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Little Jem  <sub>[v4 c34 P21](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0021)</sub>; Jem  <sub>[v4 c40 P24](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0024)</sub>; Joy  <sub>[v4 c19 P12](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0012)</sub>; Wee man  <sub>[v4 c34 P17](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0017)</sub>

## Appearance

Jem is a plump, fair-skinned baby with hazel eyes, dimpled elbows, and a forehead resembling his father's. He has fine downy hair with a reddish tint, and well-shaped ears that lie flat against his head.

_Sources: [v4 c19 P7](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0007), [v4 c19 P12](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0012), [v4 c19 P14](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0014), [v4 c19 P17](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0017), [v4 c35 P5](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0005)_

## Personality

Jem is a cheerful, healthy, and sweet-tempered infant who smiles readily and enjoys affection from those around him. He is spirited enough to make a hearty noise when vocalizing his presence. He forms quick attachments to his family and caregivers, reacting happily to their cuddles and baby talk.

_Sources: [v4 c19 P7](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0007), [v4 c19 P33](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0033), [v4 c19 P35](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0035), [v4 c28 P9](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0009), [v4 c34 P33](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0033)_

- Good-natured  <sub>[v4 c19 P35](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0035)</sub>
- Healthy and robust  <sub>[v4 c19 P7](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0007), [v4 c34 P33](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0033)</sub>

## Abilities

- Beginning to vocalize baby sounds  <sub>[v4 c35 P8](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0008)</sub>

## History

Jem was born in the early summer at the house of dreams in Four Winds, the second child of Anne and Gilbert Blythe after the loss of his older sister, Joy. He was named James Matthew in honor of Captain Jim Boyd and Matthew Cuthbert. He grew into a healthy, thriving infant, bringing immense happiness to his parents and household after their previous grief. During his infancy, he was adored and cared for by his mother, Susan Baker, Marilla Cuthbert, and neighboring friends like Leslie Moore, Miss Cornelia, and Captain Jim. In the autumn following his first birthday, he moved with his parents and Susan from the house of dreams to the larger Morgan property at Glen St. Mary.

_Sources: [v4 c19 P0](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0000), [v4 c19 P8](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0008), [v4 c19 P12](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0012), [v4 c19 P21](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0021), [v4 c34 P21](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0021), [v4 c34 P33](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0033), [v4 c40 P58](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0058)_
